run_form_composer_task: run the form composer demo task on EC2 with MTurk sandbox using the dynamic example config
generate_data_json_config: generate an extrapolated task_data.json config file from form and token values config files
generate_preview_html: generate an HTML preview of a MTurk task form from the task_data.json config file
launch_task_with_operator: launch a Mephisto task run on EC2/MTurk sandbox using the Operator with shared static task state
build_form_composer_dynamic_ec2: build the form composer dynamic React app on EC2 for MTurk sandbox deployment
